Before writing this, please check the **Deliberate non-features** table in
`README.md`. Ten things are absent on purpose — no LLM, no gaze tracking, no
server or account, no exercise library, no streaks or badges, no posture
detection, no acuity score, no calibration wizard, no signed exports. Each row
says which constraint forces the absence. Arguing against one of those
constraints is a perfectly good issue; proposing the feature without addressing
the constraint is not.

## Which constraint does it touch

- [ ] It would add a dependency (one runtime, four dev today)
- [ ] It would make a network request
- [ ] It would need a server, an account, or a store outside the browser profile
- [ ] It would put a number on screen that is not measured
- [ ] It would add motion, colour, or a smaller type size
- [ ] None of these

If you ticked one, say why the trade is worth it.
